description: This source file contains functions that fetch and process information from a REST API related to modules, deployments, users, and costs for a data management dashboard front end. It includes utility functions for resolving the API base URL, making authenticated fetch requests, and normalizing data shapes. The main exported functions are getModules and getOverviewMetrics, which return summarized dashboard data.

methods.name: resolveBase()
methods.description: Determines the API base URL using environment configurations, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, { credentials = 'omit' } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to a given URL with specified options, handles JSON response and errors.

methods.name: toArray(data)
methods.description: Normalizes various shapes of data into an array, handling raw data, data objects with data or items properties.

methods.name: getModules()
methods.description: Fetches a list of module summaries for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints or deriving a minimal overview.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics()
methods.description: Fetches summarized metrics like total users and deployed apps for the dashboard overview.
